series.label: Maize (corn) production

sources.title: FAOSTAT Crops and livestock products
sources.note: FAO flags and units retained; production, harvested area and yield are different measures.

limitations: Production does not show who consumes, owns or profits from the crop.
Items are specific product forms: oil palm fruit is not palm oil, and seed cotton is not lint.
Source flags for estimation and imputation remain available in the table; missing countries are not zero.
series.hosted_scope_note: All retained observations for this measure in the named built-in dataset. Native dates, reporting populations and unavailable/source-ineligible values remain unchanged.
